Welcome to the redline test fixture site

This site is the deterministic input for the redline end-to-end test harness. Each page is hand-authored so that golden file tests can compare report output byte-for-byte across runs and platforms.

The pages cover the eight primary labels: aligned, stale, off-brand, contradictory, redundant, thin, zombie, and unclear. Combined with the fake LLM client that drives deterministic judgments, this fixture produces a known-good report against which we assert the report-rendering pipeline is correct.
